_comment: Tests that fail when a layer runs alone beside its declared closure (bean `ho66`), keyed `<test file> > <test>`, with `bun test`'s own fail count, which also counts errors between tests. A RATCHET: a failure not listed here is red; a listed one that now passes is reported, with this command, so the list only goes down.
